program: E (the EMT 250 program on the 246), docs/EMT250_program.md §11-17
delays: integer device samples; positions after R's first direct tap at index k0

rev_gain_db.label: the reverb's level against the direct tap; already included in loops.static_read_gain and moving_reads.reads amplitudes - do not apply it again to either

value.form: H(z) = (-g + z^-D) / (1 - g z^-D), in series, before the loops

value.feedback: negative: v[t] = u[t] - line[t - P], line = G{v}
value.read: after the loop filter (reads the line)

L.gain: as the direct path's L gain

value.law: the 246's own: tools/ml_lines.line_coefs(P, rt, lf, hf) then line_resp (shelf + HF pole, HF floor); the panel's LF / HF multiply the loop law

altiverb_family.note: adopted LF 1.49 / HF 0.69; LF from the 63-500 Hz decay (§16.5), HF from the 2-12.4 kHz decay (§17.3), held out. Earlier §11.2 / §12.4 / §13.6 / §15 values (1.44 / 0.72 and 1.38 / 0.74) are superseded

value.meaning: nine fixed reads on the loop lines, taken BEFORE the loop filter (v[t] = u[t] - line[t - P], line = G{v}; the static reads take line, after G; §17) (centre = output delay after R's direct tap, loop, signed R and L amplitudes, direct tap = 1), each read at centre + A x triangle(f_j t + phase_j), triangle in [-1, 1], phase independent per read and realisation, rate f_j = f x (1 +- fsd) per read; L reads the same address with its own amplitude, mdel samples later, or mdel + dl_same for the reads whose L and R signs agree (§16.7); integer addresses, no interpolation
value.speed_spread: f_j = f x U(1 - fsd, 1 + fsd) per read and realisation (fsd 0.5); phases are independent (common false)
value.one_pole: after summing the reads and before L's offset: y[n] = (1 - mlp) x[n] + mlp y[n-1], mlp = 0.07, applied to both the R and L moving sums
value.l_gain: reads[].L is the final L output amplitude: do NOT multiply L's moving path by gL again. The 1.114 gL applies to the direct path and the static reverb only; the L moving offset is mdel (314), or 315 for reads whose R and L signs agree
value.provenance: the static reads and fixed_reads.json were fitted with render_mean, which omits dl_same and the mlp one-pole; validate the moving part with e_sim.render, not render_mean

plugin_faithful.filter_position: the plugin-faithful reads take the loop line AFTER the loop filter; the adopted fixed reads take v before it
plugin_faithful.lfo: the common triangle's 0.5535 Hz holds with lfo='time'; lfo='samples' adds 0.0005
plugin_faithful.note: §14.4-14.5: the UAD plugin's structure; a listening alternative. Its old comparison (250 vs 182) was against the superseded random-read law; the adopted fixed-read law is about 86-91

moving_reads.label: S (reads, amplitudes, depth: E's low band, held out; speed spread: E's statistics) / H (triangle shape and rate: the UAD plugin)

value.note: L's output kernel, applied to BOTH output channels in the 'device' chain at sample offset 16 (taps 16 and 17); the static reference IRs compensate this 16-sample delay so R's direct tap is at k0. E has it, the LP lever does not cause it

capture_chain_tail.value: the Altiverb captures' chain has a slow tail (analysis/e250/kernel_tail.json, B-spline 540-4000 samples); a property of the capture chain, not of E: the plugin's own analogue chain replaces it
capture_chain_tail.label: S

value.note: the Altiverb family's steps; the 246's E table itself is unknown

LF_HF.value: the 246's LF x / HF x controls through the loop law; adopted family values LF 1.49 / HF 0.69
LF_HF.label: S (shape) / H (same code)

value.reference: the Altiverb family taken as AMPL 80

DELAY.value: a pure delay of the whole output, 0-999 ms, device samples; the Altiverb family at 0
DELAY.label: H

onset.value: at DELAY 0 E's R direct tap arrives with M's first cluster tap (Altiverb: S 10.17 / M 20.33 / L 40.42 / E 20.33 ms, one capture chain)
onset.label: S

level.value: E's direct tap 1 at the level of an S / M / L cluster tap at the same AMPL (the Altiverb normalised every preset to equal total energy, 64.3-64.6 dB, so the absolute program levels are not in the data)
level.label: H (calibration guess)

value.guess: 2nd-order Butterworth at the device rate below 12 kHz

capture_pretap.value: the Altiverb captures carry a deterministic, non-causal low-band component before the direct tap (deconvolution): e_model.pretap, for comparisons with captures only
capture_pretap.label: S

not_resolved: E's LFO rate within 0.5-0.65 Hz (E's own statistics; 0.553 = the 250's in seconds, adopted, or 0.608 = in samples) and the triangle shape (the UAD plugin; E cannot tell triangle from sine)

references.static_ir_note: render_ir(rt, moving=False, chain='device'), adopted LF 1.49 / HF 0.69, AMPL 80, DELAY 0, LP open; device rate (the exact device_rate_hz; the WAV header is the integer wav_sample_rate_hz), (L, R), R's tap at index k0; lengths int(secs*FS) with secs = min(3 RT + 0.5, 4.0), so the RT 4.5 reference is truncated at 0.89 RT
references.targets_note: e_sim.stats of the eight RT >= 1.0 Altiverb presets; the adopted fixed-read generator lands at about 86-91 (lower is better) against the data's own half-vs-half cost of 100. lobes and lr use leave-one-out residuals; e_ratio and frac use the static model residual
